intro: A Glowing Soul Gem is a dark ritual artifact carried by operatives of the Cult of the Dark Strand in northern Ashenvale. Imbued with shadowy sorcery, the stone traps the spirit of an unwitting victim to fuel the cult's sinister operations.

p: Northeast of Maestra's Post, in the shadowed ruins of Ordil'Aran, members of the Cult of the Dark Strand wield dark sorcery under the watchful eyes of their shadowy masters. Among their ranks, operatives carry Glowing Soul Gems—vessels enchanted to trap and torment the souls of the dead. Rather than mere decorative trinkets, these stones act as conduits of magical energy, anchoring bound spirits to serve the cult's shadowy ends.
